dialogue.content: (こんばんは　宜しくお願いします。お昼の相談内容の続きからで変わりはないですか）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. It's good to see you again. Shall we pick up where we left off this afternoon, or has anything changed since then?)

dialogue.content: （はいよろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Yes, that sounds right. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: こんばんはお昼のお話を整理しますととても扱いの難しい先輩とペアでお仕事をされている。暗くなってしまうような気持ちや怖い気持ちになってしまうが少し先輩の気持ちも聞いてみようかなと思われたという状況でしたね
dialogue.English: Good evening. To summarize our conversation from this afternoon, you're paired at work with a senior colleague who is very difficult to handle. It makes you feel down and sometimes scared, but you were also thinking about trying to understand your colleague's feelings a bit more. That was the situation, correct?

dialogue.content: 他に感じられていること、お話されたい事はありますか
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you’re feeling or would like to talk about?

dialogue.content: そうですね。あと口で言うことと内心が違うのではないかと、よく思うのです。私には会社をよくしたいから皆と上手くやった方がいいよというのですが、私が他の人と話をしたり、その人のことを配慮するようなことをいうと、ちょっと気に入らないようで、私にもチクっと嫌味をいったりするんです。そういう人と付き合う上でどういうことに気をつけたらいいか聞きたいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. I also often feel that what she says and what she truly feels are different. She tells me, "For the good of the company, it's better to get along with everyone," but when I talk with other people or say something considerate about someone, she seems to dislike it and makes little snide remarks to me. I’d like to know what I should be careful about when dealing with someone like that.

dialogue.content: どう対応するといいと思われますか？
dialogue.English: How do you think I should handle it?

dialogue.content: なるほどあなたは先輩からは気に入られているような印象を受けますか
dialogue.English: I see. Do you get the impression that your senior likes you?

dialogue.content: 話しやすいのはあるかもしれません。でも私が少しでも意に沿わない行動をしたら、信じてくれなくなりそうな柔軟性に欠ける人ですね
dialogue.English: She might find me easy to talk to. But she's very inflexible; I feel like she would stop trusting me if I did even one small thing that went against her wishes.

dialogue.content: 極端な感じです。思い込み強くて。
dialogue.English: She's quite extreme. Very set in her ways and her assumptions.

dialogue.content: ええ、お付き合いに距離がないと疲れますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, it must be exhausting when you can't have some distance in the relationship.

dialogue.content: はい。でもペアだからずーっと一緒に行動なんで逃げられなくて。下手したら夜ご飯も一緒で
dialogue.English: Yes. But since we're a pair, we're always together, so I can't escape. Sometimes we even end up having dinner together.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってお付き合いしなければならない状況ですよね先輩は例えば肯定的な事を話すと信頼していただけそうですか
dialogue.English: It sounds like a situation where you have to make a great effort to get along. For example, do you think she would trust you more if you said positive, affirming things?

dialogue.content: 多分イエスマンが欲しいのかま
dialogue.English: She probably just wants a yes-man.

dialogue.content: 多分イエスマンが欲しいのかと
dialogue.English: I think she probably wants a yes-man.

dialogue.content: 自分の意見を曲げず人の意見をほんとに聞かないです。
dialogue.English: She never bends her own opinions and really doesn't listen to what others have to say.

dialogue.content: 素直に聞くタイプではないです
dialogue.English: She’s not the type to listen with an open mind.

dialogue.content: ええ先ほど自信のない方ではないかとおっしゃっていましたねそうなるとまず否定的な注意などの言葉は逆効果になりそうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, you mentioned earlier that you thought she might lack self-confidence. If that's the case, then critical remarks or corrective comments would likely be counterproductive.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。やはりアドバイス的なことをいうと危険なんですね。今まで生きてきて一番猜疑心が強い人と思いました
dialogue.English: I see. So it is risky to say anything that sounds like advice. I think she’s the most suspicious and distrustful person I’ve ever met in my life.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね例えばどのような言葉や言動が先輩にはうけいれられやすそうだと思われますか
dialogue.English: I see. For example, what kinds of words or behaviors do you think your senior colleague would be more receptive to?

dialogue.content: なかなかこんな頑固な人いないと思います
dialogue.English: I don’t think there are many people this stubborn.

dialogue.content: よく一人で頑張ってきましたねとかあなたのおかげで会社は発展しましたねとかかな。でもその人より社長のおかげだとは本心は思うので、あまり言いたくないし図に乗りそうだから、言っても良い効果があるか心配ですね
dialogue.English: Maybe things like, "You've worked so hard all by yourself," or "The company has grown thanks to you." But in my heart, I feel it's more thanks to the president than to her, so I don't really want to say that. I'm worried it would just make her conceited, so I'm not sure if it would have any positive effect.

dialogue.content: それでもやっぱり寄り添うセリフは必要でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Even so, is it still necessary to use those kinds of supportive, validating phrases?

dialogue.content: ええ、本当に先輩をよく観察していらっしゃいますね先輩の功績や何かいい所を見つけてお伝えしたりがあれば心は開くかもしれないなとは思いましたが、一つご注意いただきたいのが
dialogue.English: Yes, you've really been observing your colleague closely. I was thinking she might open up if you could find and mention her achievements or some of her good points, but there is one thing I would like you to be cautious about.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 他に信用されている方がいなそうなのであなたに依存したり、先ほども少しおっしゃっていた独占欲などが強くなると心配です
dialogue.English: Since it seems she doesn't trust anyone else, I'm concerned she might become dependent on you, or that her possessiveness, which you touched on earlier, might intensify.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。少し依存してる感じがします
dialogue.English: That's right. I already feel she's becoming a little dependent on me.

dialogue.content: そうですねそうなるとまた大変な行動をとることも考えられますのでやはりお一人で心を開かせるのは危険かもしれないですね
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, she might resort to even more difficult behavior, so it could be risky for you to try to get her to open up on your own.

dialogue.content: 例えば社長さんや他の方とみんなでその方のいい所を見つけて言葉にしていくことはいかがでしょう
dialogue.English: For instance, what if you, the president, and others worked together as a group to identify and voice her good qualities?

dialogue.content: だから他の人と話したりしてると、自分のことをウワサしてるのではないかと勘違いし悪い方に受取り、私に対してもニコニコしてると媚び売ってるみたいだという言い方されたことがあります。
dialogue.English: That's why when I talk with other people, she misunderstands and assumes we're gossiping about her, taking it in the most negative way. She's even told me that when I'm smiling at people, it looks like I'm sucking up.

dialogue.content: 社長さんもたまに褒めたりしてるようですが…もっと褒められたいのかな
dialogue.English: The president seems to praise her sometimes, but... maybe she wants to be praised even more?

dialogue.content: 媚びを売っている、、そういう風に捉えるのですねもしかするとそう言ってあなたにこちらを見てほしいと思っていることも考えられますね、、
dialogue.English: "Sucking up"... so that's how she perceives it. It's also possible that by saying that, she's trying to get you to pay more attention to her.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。でも私も性格のきつい先輩より他の普通の人と仲良くしたいのが本心なんですよね
dialogue.English: Exactly. But honestly, my true feeling is that I'd rather get along with other, normal people than with a senior who has such a difficult personality.

dialogue.content: 年は食ってるのに、確かに子どもみたいな人ですね。甘えん坊みたいな…
dialogue.English: Even though she’s older, she really is like a child. Like a spoiled child who needs a lot of attention.

dialogue.content: ええ、そんな印象を受けます。なので承認の言葉が必要な気がしますが、、依存だけが気になります
dialogue.English: Yes, I get that impression as well. That's why I feel that words of validation are necessary, but it's the dependency that concerns me.

dialogue.content: 私もそう感じます。どうするのがいいか迷います
dialogue.English: I feel the same way. I'm not sure what the best thing to do is.

dialogue.content: やはりお一人で抱えず、なるべく多くのかたで対応したほうがいいと思いますが、可能でしょうか
dialogue.English: Again, I think it's better not to handle this by yourself, but to involve as many people as possible. Would that be feasible?

dialogue.content: そうですよね〜今までも散々なだめたり、優しくしたりいろいろ対応したようですが変わらなかったようで、周りの人は関わりを持とうとしません。本人も信用してないみたいだし。私は最近異動したので、ペアになってしまったようです。私の役目はキツイ彼女の代わりにクッション役になってほしいみたいな要望でした。
dialogue.English: You're right. It seems others have tried all sorts of things in the past, like placating her or being kind, but she never changed, so now people around her avoid getting involved. And she doesn't seem to trust them, either. I was transferred recently, so I'm the one who got paired with her. The request was basically for me to act as a "cushion" for her difficult personality.

dialogue.content: クッション役、、、それは負担は大きい気がしますがどのように思われましたか
dialogue.English: A "cushion" role... That sounds like a heavy burden. How did you feel about that?

dialogue.content: でもずっと気を使いすぎて私のメンタルが…
dialogue.English: But being so considerate all the time is taking a toll on my mental health…

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That's completely understandable.

dialogue.content: 最初は、私もそのくらいなら大丈夫と思いましたがあまりに強烈な人で日々疲労しています
dialogue.English: At first, I thought I could handle it, but she is such an intense person that I'm exhausted every single day.

dialogue.content: 会社の功労者ではあるようで、クビなどにはできないようです
dialogue.English: It seems she's considered a person of great service to the company, so they can't just fire her.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええあなたがクッション役を一人で担ってはいくら聡明なかたでもいいことはないです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. It's not good for you to bear the role of "cushion" all by yourself, no matter how capable you are.

dialogue.content: 功労者とはどういったことでしょうか
dialogue.English: In what way is she a person of great service?

dialogue.content: 会社に貢献した方みたいで。
dialogue.English: It seems she has contributed a lot to the company.

dialogue.content: なるほどそこに対しての評価は十分だったと思われますか
dialogue.English: I see. Do you feel she has been sufficiently recognized for that?

dialogue.content: 確かに会社の柱の一本だったかもしれませんが現在は完全モラハラだと思います。
dialogue.English: She may have been one of the pillars of the company in the past, but right now I think what she does is outright psychological harassment.

dialogue.content: 以前は柱だったのですねお仕事に情熱があった時期があったということでしょうか
dialogue.English: So she used to be a pillar. Does that mean there was a time when she was passionate about her work?

dialogue.content: いまもやる気は社内一番くらいあります
dialogue.English: She still has more motivation than almost anyone else in the company.

dialogue.content: お金の為に働くというより、会社をもっと大きくしたいと思ってます。なんでかわからないんだけど
dialogue.English: It's less about working for the money and more that she wants to make the company bigger. I don't know why, though.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかなるほど名を残したいといったイメージでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see. So is it something like she wants to leave a legacy?

dialogue.content: 多分ずっと会社にいたいのだと思います。他に趣味も友達もいなさそうだし
dialogue.English: I think she probably wants to be at the company forever. It doesn't seem like she has any other hobbies or friends.

dialogue.content: 功労者としての自覚、プライドがあるのかもしれないですね会社が居場所なのですね
dialogue.English: She may have a sense of pride from her awareness of being a major contributor. The company is her place of belonging.

dialogue.content: そうですそうです！会社で威張ってるのが楽しいのかなと思ったこともあります。多分大事な居場所で、無くしたら元気なくなるタイプかも
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly! I’ve even thought that maybe she enjoys throwing her weight around at the company. It’s probably an important place for her to belong, and she's the type who would lose her spark if she lost it.

dialogue.content: やはりそのあたりの評価をあなた一人ではなく全体で気持ちを伝えていくと満たされるかもしれませんそしてやはりあなたが一人で抱えて辛い思いをしないでほしいなと思いました
dialogue.English: As I was thinking, she might feel fulfilled if that appreciation is conveyed by the entire group, not just by you alone. And again, I really don't want you to have to carry this burden and suffer by yourself.

dialogue.content: ここまでお話してみていかがですか
dialogue.English: How are you feeling now that we've talked it through this far?

dialogue.content: なるほど…全体で伝えるのはグッドですねでもほぼ全員に嫌われてるので労ってくれるかどうか…💦
dialogue.English: I see… Having the whole group convey it is a good idea, but she's disliked by almost everyone, so I’m not sure they’d be willing to show any appreciation for her efforts… 💦

dialogue.content: だいぶスッキリしました。人の悪口みたいになるのでなかなか相談することを躊躇していたので…思ってたことを話せてスッキリしました
dialogue.English: I feel much better now. I was hesitant to talk about this because it feels like bad-mouthing someone, but I feel relieved now that I've been able to say what was on my mind.

dialogue.content: もちろん、嫌っている人たちは嫌な顔をするかもしれませんしかしあなたを守るために、社長など適任な方からお話していただければと思います
dialogue.English: Of course, the people who dislike her might show their reluctance. However, to protect you, I think it would be best to have a suitable person, like the president, be the one to speak to her.

dialogue.content: そうですよねーほんとーに強烈な人なんですよ〜私一人じゃ無理です
dialogue.English: You're right. She's a really, truly intense person. I can't do this alone.

dialogue.content: 悪口ではないと思います。お仕事を気持ちよくするためにここに来られたのだと思いますええ、強烈な方ですがうまく乗り越えられれば今後どんな方がきてもあなたはうまくやっていける気がします
dialogue.English: I don't think it's bad-mouthing at all. I believe you came here to find a way to make your work life more comfortable. Yes, she is an intense person, but if you can get through this successfully, I feel you'll be able to handle anyone who comes your way in the future.

dialogue.content: 確かにラスボスクラスです。確かにそう思います。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: She’s definitely on the level of a final boss. I agree. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: あなたの明るさがあれば良い方向にむかっていけるような気がします。またぜひいらしてくださいね
dialogue.English: With your bright personality, I feel you can steer things in a good direction. Please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: また聞いてください今日はありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: I'll be sure to talk with you again. Thank you for today!

dialogue.content: それでは終了のメッセージが流れますありがとうございました頑張ってください！
dialogue.English: A message will now play to end our session. Thank you for your time, and please take care!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much for your time today.)
